phase: 63 GiB of persistent /private/var, and the system reaches the home screen

result.capacity_display: Capacity 69 GB correct; Available reads Zero KB and is unexplained

what_changed_from_794.volume: 174 MiB inside xnusys -> a new 64 GiB GPT partition before xnusys
what_changed_from_794.write_path: one 4096-byte WRITE(10) per block -> up to 64 blocks (256 KiB) per command

partition_table.why_a_new_partition: the APFS container sits at offset 0 of xnusys, so moving xnusys's start would move 2.32 GiB of iOS root. A new partition in front of it costs no copying.
partition_table.verification: each step conv=fsync then read back and compared md5 against the host image; all four matched
partition_table.not_written: the last 34 blocks, 26 of which belong to flashinfo

multi_block_write.why: single-block writes measured 20 ms each, 0.2 MB/s — a 1 GB install would take 85 minutes
multi_block_write.limit_is_not_the_cdb: WRITE(10) CDB[7..8] holds up to 65535 blocks; the ceiling is the JESD223 single-PRD cap of 256 KiB (prd[3] is 18 bits, 0x3ffff)

implementation.driver: hakios.xnusys_blk.c coalesces contiguous runs up to ufs_write_max_blocks; partial writes still read-modify-write the edges
implementation.kill_switch: boot arg ufs_write_max_blocks=1 falls back to single-block

multi_block_write.prior_art_on_this_device: loader-src/mtk/loader/ufs.h:355-368 and 781-790 already drive multi-block READ(10)/WRITE(10) up to 8 MiB on the same UFSHCI, same LK queue 0x51266400, same UCD 0x60101000, same DMA buffer 0x6010e000, same LUN 2

794_174MiB: yes, but volume fills in 60 s

render_proof: MiniIOMobileFramebuffer: 51 frames in 5001 ms (10 a second), 1411 us each
MiniIOMobileFramebuffer: this frame on average red 61 green 63 blue 64; 29% of it not black
cpu_monitor_note: 701 refusals in Trial796 is the same count both ramfs baselines show. It is background noise, not a fault. Corpse stays at 0.

bugs_found_and_fixed_this_round.what: read LBA 8 (4096-byte LBA 1, the GPT header) and demanded CRC32 == 0x28a2836c, the value before the carve
bugs_found_and_fixed_this_round.fix: 0xec726acc, and the two failure modes printed separately
bugs_found_and_fixed_this_round.symptom: ufs-read guard: predecessor READ/reference failed; manual fastboot required

bugs_found_and_fixed_this_round.unchanged: all nine chain[] entries — the carve touched no byte of xnusys

bugs_found_and_fixed_this_round.what: used the offsets 608448..653559 that exist *inside* xnusys as if they were absolute LBAs; after the carve that span is inside partition 77, super
bugs_found_and_fixed_this_round.contained_by: the inner guard still refused those addresses, so nothing was written

bugs_found_and_fixed_this_round.what: upper bound was `> 653560`, an xnusys offset; the new volume's block 0 is absolute 13803264 and was refused
bugs_found_and_fixed_this_round.fix: first and last block tested against both absolute windows
two disjoint windows; deliberately not a min/max span, because 600k blocks of APFS container sit between them

bugs_found_and_fixed_this_round.what: DKIOCGETPHYSICALBLOCKSIZE fell through to eno_ioctl(), which returns ENXIO; hfs_mountfs only tolerates ENOTSUP and ENOTTY and turns everything else into a failed mount
bugs_found_and_fixed_this_round.fix: implement the ioctl (512) and make default return ENOTTY, as xnusys_var always has
bugs_found_and_fixed_this_round.symptom: hfs_mountfs: DKIOCGETPHYSICALBLOCKSIZE failed / hfs_mount: hfs_mountfs returned error=6

android_side.after_carve: fastboot -w reformatted userdata at 39.975586 GiB; boot_completed=1
android_side.near_miss: before the reformat, Android mounted the old F2FS superblock that still claimed 104 GiB, so /data extended past the new boundary into xnuvar. Rebooted to fastboot immediately; formatted before any further use.

open_question.symptom: Settings shows Capacity 69 GB (correct: 64 GiB = 68.72 GB decimal) and Available Zero KB
checked_and_ruled_out: reserveBlocks is computed only under `if (!data)` (root mount); we pass args, so it stays 0
hfs_freeblks subtracts reserve + loanedBlocks + lockedBlocks, all zero with no writes in flight
vfs_attrlist.c:1447 multiplies f_bsize * f_bavail in off_t, 64-bit, no overflow
open_question.why_it_matters: if installd reads this to decide whether there is room, installs would be refused even though the volume is 90% empty
open_question.next_step: add a probe printing freeBlocks / reserveBlocks / loanedBlocks / lockedBlocks in hfs_vfs_getattr, or test once USB gives a way to run statfs inside iOS
